title: Automation Testing Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Roles and Responsibility**
* Design, develop, and execute automated tests for APIs using various tools and technologies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify and prioritize testing requirements.
* Develop and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts.
* Analyze and report defects found during testing.
* Participate in agile development methodologies and contribute to process improvements.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in API automation testing.
